items: ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 9.2): Commissions 1,000 Forest Guards, Proposes ₦10M Per-Ward Security Grants Across 147 Wards, Revives Road Agency ZAROMA & Delivers Crash Relief
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 9.0): Launches Mastercard-Backed ICT Training for 2,500 Young Women (2,000 Guaranteed Jobs), Inspects ₦165M Obubra PHC & Supports Obudu Quadruplets
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.9): Graduates 1,200 Up-Skilled Artisans with Tools, Hosts 2,500+ at Lagos Job Fair 2026, Equips PLHIV Entrepreneurs & Trains Teachers on Resilience
EDO STATE (PSI 8.8): Flags Off 10.89km Evbareke Market Road & 19 Streets, Launches State-Local Civil Service Council, Trains Principals on Security & Pays Twin Medical Bills
KATSINA STATE (PSI 8.6): Katsina GDP Expands 11.53% to ₦10.13 Trillion as Gov. Radda Wins National Security Governance Award
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 8.5): Gov. Eno Advances NSIA–OCP 2.5M MTPA Ammonia & Fertilizer Plant in Ikot Abasi and Plans Creative Village with ISFF
GOMBE STATE (PSI 8.3): Flags Off 12.7km Tudu Kwaya–Panguru Road, Commissions Billiri West LCDA Secretariat & Validates 3-Year UNICEF M&E Roadmap
NIGER STATE (PSI 8.1): Gov. Bago Visits Borgu Clash Victims with ₦148M Relief & Orders Inquiry; Receives Judicial Panel Report on 37 Miners' Deaths
ENUGU STATE (PSI 7.9): Gov. Mbah Inspects Marriott-Managed Enugu Five-Star Hotel & Opens 40km Rural Connectivity Dual Carriageway
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 7.6): Gov. Namadi Accelerates Tsangaya Education Reform & Almajiri Begging-Free Zone Initiative with 3 Mega Boarding Schools
ANAMBRA STATE (PSI 7.5): VP Shettima & Gov. Soludo Commission Ekwulobia Flyover Complex & Hold Stakeholders Town Hall in Isuofia
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 7.1): Gov. Mutfwang Orders Security Action After Deadly Tafi Gani Attack in Bassa LGA as EXCO Mourns Governor's Brother
ABIA STATE (PSI 6.9): Ministry of Trade & ACCIMA Open 10-Day Aba International Trade Fair 2026 ('Aba Beyond Borders')
OYO STATE (PSI 6.8): Oyo Advances Construction of 12MW Independent Gas Power Plant & 30km 33kV Transmission Line
OSUN STATE (PSI 6.6): Gov. Adeleke Directs Police to Halt Planned Infiltration by Proscribed NURTW Ahead of Second-Term Inauguration
BORNO STATE (PSI 6.5): Gov. Zulum Mourns Biu–Damaturu Road Crash Victims & Reschedules Southern Borno Zonal Rally to Dec 2
RIVERS STATE (PSI 6.3): Gov. Fubara Hosts Rivers Hoopers Basketball Team to Celebrate Historic 7th Consecutive National Title
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 6.2): Deputy Gov. Farauta Bids Farewell to First Batch of 2026 Christian Pilgrims Departing Yola for Israel & Jordan
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 6.0): Gov. Sule Formally Welcomes Incoming NSCDC State Commandant Bala Bawa Bodinga in Lafia

ZAMFARA (PSI 9.2): Gov. Dauda Lawal commissioned 1,000 newly trained Forest Guards across 13 LGAs with logistics support, proposed ₦10 million per ward across all 147 wards for community youth security volunteers while reiterating zero negotiation with bandits, reactivated the Zamfara State Roads Maintenance Agency (ZAROMA) to rehabilitate Takama Road in Gusau, and dispatched Deputy Gov. Mani Malam Mummuni alongside Sen. Abdulaziz Yari (who donated ₦52.5m and 275 grain bags) to deliver cash and food relief to Gummi road crash victims.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.0): Cross River signed an MoU for the Mastercard Foundation-backed Technology Talent Service (TTS) programme to train 2,500 young women across all 18 LGAs with 2,000 guaranteed remote jobs (reserving 10% for women with disabilities and 5% for IDPs); Health Commissioner Dr. Henry Egbe Ayuk inspected the new ₦165 million Apiapum Primary Health Centre with staff quarters in Obubra LGA; and First Lady Bishop Eyoawan Otu donated ₦300,000 and household supplies to the Obudu quadruplets.

LAGOS (PSI 8.9): Gov. Babajide Sanwo-Olu graduated 1,200 up-skilled tradesmen and artisans with working kits in Ikeja; hosted over 2,500 job seekers at the Lagos Employment Summit 4.0 Job Fair 2026 at UNILAG targeting 250+ verified jobs; empowered People Living with HIV with vocational equipment via LSACA ahead of World AIDS Day; and trained senior secondary teachers on school disaster risk assessment via LASRO.

EDO (PSI 8.8): Gov. Monday Okpebholo flagged off construction of the 10.89km Evbareke Spare Parts Market Road and 19 adjoining streets in Egor LGA; HOS Dr. Anthony Okungbowa unveiled the pioneering State-Local Civil Service Collaborative Council; Gov. Okpebholo charged South-South school principals on campus security while pledging 3,000 new teacher hires; and First Lady's Office Coordinator Mrs. Edesili Anani offset a ₦500,000+ hospital bill for a mother of newborn twins.

KATSINA (PSI 8.6): The Katsina State GDP Report 2024–2025 (compiled with NBS and the World Bank) confirmed nominal economic expansion of 11.53% from ₦9.08 trillion to ₦10.13 trillion driven by services (53.60%), agriculture (₦2.41tn), and manufacturing (₦1.72tn), while Gov. Dikko Umaru Radda was named Governor of the Year on Security by Nigerian NewsDirect for establishing the Community Watch Corps.

AKWA IBOM (PSI 8.5): Gov. Umo Eno hosted NSIA MD Aminu Umar-Sadiq and Morocco's OCP Group executives in Uyo to advance construction of an Ikot Abasi industrial complex producing 1.5 million MTPA of ammonia and 1 million MTPA of specialty fertilizers, while also receiving ISFF CEO Chief Lancelot Imasuen to reaffirm plans for a state Creative Village ahead of Christmas Unplugged 4.0.

GOMBE (PSI 8.3): Gov. Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya flagged off the 12.7km first section of the Ayaba–Kwaya–Tudu–Kuran Mota–Panguru Road (with 30% contractor mobilization paid), commissioned the solar-powered Billiri West LCDA Secretariat ahead of December 1 LCDA operations, and closed the UNICEF-backed workshop validating Gombe's three-year M&E roadmap.

NIGER (PSI 8.1): Gov. Mohammed Umaru Bago visited Borgu Emirate following communal clashes, ordering a thorough investigation and announcing ₦2 million each (₦148m total) plus foodstuffs and building materials for 74 bereaved families, and separately received the three-volume Judicial Commission of Inquiry report on the deaths of 37 artisanal miners in NSCDC custody, pledging full implementation.

ENUGU (PSI 7.9): Gov. Peter Mbah conducted an unscheduled inspection of the ongoing Enugu Five-Star Hotel to be managed by Marriott International and opened Phase One of a 40km dual carriageway cutting across Nkanu East, Isi-Uzo, and Udenu LGAs to divert northbound heavy-duty trucks from Enugu metropolis.

JIGAWA (PSI 7.6): During a visit to Guiwa Tsangaya Boarding Primary School, Gov. Umar Namadi reaffirmed Jigawa's campaign to eliminate child street begging by integrating Qur'anic, formal, and vocational education across three nearing-completion Mega Tsangaya Schools in Dutse, Ringim, and Kafin-Hausa, supported by 500 J-Tsangaya teachers and NBAIS certification for 277 Alarammomi.

ANAMBRA (PSI 7.5): Vice President Kashim Shettima joined Gov. Chukwuma Soludo to commission the Ekwulobia Flyover Complex and Ancillary Structures before holding an interactive town hall meeting in Umueze-Isuofia with Anambra traditional rulers, town union presidents-general, women, and youth leaders.

PLATEAU (PSI 7.1): Gov. Caleb Mutfwang directed security operatives to stabilize Tafi Gani community in Miango District, Bassa LGA, following a deadly attack and urged residents against reprisals, while the Plateau State Executive Council issued a condolence message over the passing of the Governor's elder brother, Arc. Morris Molkat Manasseh Mutfwang.

ABIA (PSI 6.9): The Abia State Ministry of Trade and Commerce, in partnership with the Aba Chamber of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture (ACCIMA), opened the Aba International Trade Fair 2026 (Nov 27 – Dec 6) at Ogbonnaya Onu Polytechnic, Aba, showcasing local footwear, fashion, agro-products, and renewable energy solutions.
OYO (PSI 6.8): The Oyo State Government reported ongoing construction and installation progress on its 12MW Independent Gas Power Plant alongside a dedicated 30-kilometre, 33kV transmission line.

OSUN (PSI 6.6): Gov. Ademola Adeleke directed the Osun State Commissioner of Police to prevent members of the proscribed National Union of Road Transport Workers (NURTW) from staging an unauthorized gathering at Old Garage, Osogbo, ahead of his Friday second-term inauguration.

BORNO (PSI 6.5): Gov. Babagana Umara Zulum condoled with Biu Emirate over the deaths of two supporters and injuries to eleven others in a crash along the Biu–Damaturu road, immediately rescheduling the Southern Borno APC Zonal Rally from November 28 to December 2, 2026.

RIVERS (PSI 6.3): Gov. Siminalayi Fubara hosted the Rivers Hoopers Basketball Team at Government House, Port Harcourt, to celebrate their historic seventh consecutive Nigerian Basketball Premier League championship ahead of their continental representation.

ADAMAWA (PSI 6.2): Deputy Gov. Prof. Kaletapwa George Farauta bade farewell to the first batch of Adamawa Christian pilgrims departing Yola International Airport aboard Alexandria Airlines for Israel and Jordan, urging them to pray for peace and peaceful 2027 elections upon their safe arrival.

NASARAWA (PSI 6.0): Gov. Abdullahi Sule received incoming NSCDC State Commandant Bala Bawa Bodinga alongside outgoing Commandant Brah Samson Umoru in Lafia to ensure smooth security command transition.
